summary: Build a web-based invoice + inventory management system for a packed drinking water/beverages business, including customer/vendor/user management, sales/purchase/inventory tracking, A5 invoice generation with downloadable PDF, Paytm UPI QR payments, dashboard analytics, ledger/pending payments tracking, role-based login/permissions, and business reports.
architectural_notes: Navigation structure: top navbar with Register (Vendor/Customer/User), Inventory (Inventory/Sales/Purchase/Order Book/Ledger), Invoice, and Settings.
Invoice format requirement: A5 paper size, aligned layout, includes delivery person + delivered-to fields and firm contact block (DHARA ENTERPRISES, phone, address, website, email).
Theme requirement: simple white + premium black styling (limited accent colors).
known_issues: Initial admin credentials provided (admin001/admin001) are insecure if left unchanged; require forced change and secure storage.

existing_features.title: Implement a username/password login system with role-based permissions, including an initial admin account (username: admin001, password: admin001) and enforcement that only admins can manage users and access admin-only settings.

Create the top navigation bar and page structure with these sections and dropdowns: Register (Vendor, Customer, User), Inventory (Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Order Book, Ledger), Invoice, Reports, and Settings.
Implement Vendor and Customer management: add/register new vendors and customers, list them, and allow deletion from the Register section.
Implement User management (admin-only): create new users, assign roles/permissions, list users, and delete/disable users from Register > User.
Implement Inventory item management: add new stock items, edit them, delete them, and track stock with dates for when items came into inventory and when sold.

Implement Purchase entry module (Inventory > Purchase): allow recording purchases including vendor, items, quantities, purchase date, and purchase price (cost). Purchases must increase on-hand inventory and be stored for reporting.

Implement Sales entry module (Inventory > Sales): allow recording sales including customer, items, quantities, sale date, selling price, and delivery person name, and support marking payment status (paid/unpaid/partial). Sales must decrease on-hand inventory and drive pending payment tracking.

Implement Order Book (Inventory > Order Book): show all orders/items sold with quantity, delivery person name, date, and price; support filtering/searching and status visibility for payment (paid/pending).

Implement Ledger (Inventory > Ledger) that automatically fetches entries from Order Book/Sales and calculates balances, showing a running total and the final positive/negative balance at the bottom; pending payments must be clearly indicated.

Build the Dashboard home page with: (1) a sales chart, (2) a pending payments list showing amount and person name, and (3) a low-inventory widget showing products low in stock with remaining quantity.

Implement Invoice creation and rendering with a properly aligned “original invoice” A5 layout, including: item code, item name, quantity, date, delivery person name, delivered-to customer, and firm details: DHARA ENTERPRISES; phone 9891860870; address C-134A Raju Park Near Sainik Farms Eastern Avenue New Delhi -80; website dharagroups.in; email dharaindiaenterprises@gmail.com.
Make invoices downloadable as a file (PDF) in A5 size.

Add Paytm UPI QR payment support for invoices: show a scannable QR code that encodes a UPI payment request with the exact invoice total so the payer sees the total amount and can pay that exact amount.

Create a Settings section in the navbar with admin-only controls to change user IDs/passwords and manage other core business/payment settings (including Paytm/UPI QR configuration used for invoice QR generation).
Implement a simple, premium UI theme using primarily white and black with minimal accent colors, applied consistently across all pages and components.
Add a Reports section that includes: (a) daily/monthly sales summary, (b) profit/loss calculation, and (c) tax reports (GST if applicable), computed from stored purchase and sales data.

new_feature_requests.summary: User authentication with role-based access/permissions; admin-only settings to manage user IDs/passwords
Customer and vendor registration management (add/delete) plus user registration from a unified Register section
Inventory item management with stock in/out, ability to add/delete items, and tracking of purchase/arrival date and selling date
Sales and purchase entry modules under Inventory section (Sales, Purchase)
Order Book module to record sold items with quantity, delivery person name, date, and price
Ledger module that auto-fetches from Order Book, shows balances, and highlights pending payments (e.g., red)
Invoice module: properly aligned original-style A5 invoice with required fields (item code/name/qty/date/delivery details), firm details, and downloadable invoice (PDF)
Paytm UPI QR payment support with scannable code that shows the exact invoice total for payment
Dashboard home page: sales chart, pending payments list (amount + person), and low-inventory alert widget showing remaining qty
Reporting: daily/monthly sales summaries, profit/loss calculation, and tax reports (GST if applicable)
